items.name: 03b-double-sided
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian modern farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, tidy and organized, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, warm white walls, sage green, brass and black metal accents, soft natural daylight. A narrow but comfortable double-sided walk-in closet: hanging rods with clothes on both facing walls, upper shelves with linen boxes, a clear aisle down the middle, oak floor, a round brass ceiling light, a framed abstract art print and a small wall hook on the end wall (no mirror). Symmetrical view down the aisle.
